name: bugfix-logclean

cursor.frontmatter:
name: bugfix-logclean
description: >-
  After a confirmed fix, finds this task's diagnostic tags from the message,
  the conversation, or the uncommitted diff, then deletes one-shot logs or
  drops them to debug. Use when the user names bugfix-logclean, says the fix
  is confirmed and the probe logs can go, or asks to remove or downgrade
  diagnostic logs. Edits the repo.
disable-model-invocation: true
